original_title: Hundraåringen som klev ut genom fönstret och försvann
overview: After living a long and colorful life, Allan Karlsson finds himself stuck in a nursing home. On his 100th birthday, he leaps out a window and begins an unexpected journey.
tagline: For a century he's made the world uncertain, and now he is on the loose again.
title: The 100 Year-Old Man Who Climbed Out the Window and Disappeared

release_dates.note: Festival: Cine Nórdico en Cine UC
